title: OpenClaw Daily Briefing on Telegram: Build a 4-Source Morning Digest
summary: Configure your OpenClaw agent to send a comprehensive Telegram daily briefing covering calendar, email, news, and habits. Full HEARTBEAT.md setup, timing config, and reliability tips.
body_markdown: Yes. OpenClaw agents are conversational — reply to any Telegram message and the agent responds. Ask it to draft a reply to the priority email, add a task to your list based on a meeting, or dig deeper into a news item. The briefing is a scheduled output; back-and-forth conversation is always available. This is what separates OpenClaw from Zapier or IFTTT automations.
